name: guardrails-development
description: Development standards: look before building, test what changed, pass the repo's checks, keep the rules in view.

searchBeforeBuild.title: search-before-build
searchBeforeBuild.description: Hold a new code file of 10+ lines (or an edit adding 60+) until the session shows research into whether it already exists.

researchTools.title: search-before-build: what counts as research
researchTools.description: Comma-separated tool names. 'Agent:Explore' names an agent type, 'Skill:*search*' a skill; '*' is a wildcard. Empty uses web search and fetch, research agents, and search skills or MCP tools.

searchSkipPaths.title: search-before-build: paths to skip
searchSkipPaths.description: Comma-separated path fragments where throwaway code is fine. Empty uses /tmp/, /temp/, /scratchpad/.

searchWarnOnly.title: search-before-build: warn only
searchWarnOnly.description: Let the write through and add a warning instead of refusing it.

testReminder.title: test-reminder
testReminder.description: After a source file changes, name the test that covers it, once per file per session.

precommitCheck.title: precommit-check
precommitCheck.description: Before a git commit, run the checks the repo lists; refuse the commit if one fails.

precommitFile.title: precommit-check: checks file
precommitFile.description: Relative to each repo's root. One shell command per line; '#' starts a comment. Repos without it are not checked.

precommitTimeoutSeconds.title: precommit-check: timeout per check (seconds)
precommitTimeoutSeconds.description: A check still running after this counts as failed. At most 600.

blockNoVerify.title: precommit-check: refuse --no-verify
blockNoVerify.description: A commit that skips the repo's own hooks needs your one-time approval code.

rulesPersist.title: rules-persist
rulesPersist.description: Re-add your core rules after a compaction, resume, clear or model switch, and give every subagent its own rules.

rulesFile.title: rules-persist: core rules file
rulesFile.description: Markdown file of the rules that must survive. '~' is your home folder. Empty turns this part off.

subagentRulesFile.title: rules-persist: subagent rules file
subagentRulesFile.description: Markdown file added to every subagent's start. Empty turns this part off.

memoryProvenance.title: memory-provenance
memoryProvenance.description: When a new memory file is written without a source and a date, ask for both.

memoryPaths.title: memory-provenance: memory folders
memoryPaths.description: Comma-separated path fragments that mark a memory file. Empty uses /memory/.

approvalMinutes.title: Approval window (minutes)
approvalMinutes.description: How long an approval code stays valid after you type it.

heartbeatDir.title: Heartbeat folder
heartbeatDir.description: Each pack writes <pack>.txt here at session start, read by /guardrails-status and the outside watchdog. '~' is your home folder. Empty turns it off.
